name: Single-thread uninterrupted versus fresh-process key-adapter continuation
scope: Engineering and TRAIN-only optimization diagnostic; never efficacy
motivation: Two fresh-process single-thread continuations matched exactly; equality to uninterrupted training and parity after switching arms remain unverified.

data.clip: First labelled prompt plus next four manifest frames; only original protocol TRAIN sequences

training: Reuse original frozen pilot initialization, AdamW, gradient clipping, segmentation/presence loss, four-frame autoregressive update and native predicted memory writes. No architecture, loss, label, hyperparameter or data-split change.
checks: Native-video and cached-feature replay match bitwise for both clips before each arm and after training
Zero adapter matches native across every tracked memory field and all four frames; do not relax parity
Input features, prompt banks and SAM2 weights remain unchanged
Every update has finite nonzero adapter gradients and native layer/pointer/value/position invariants
Same source, checkpoint, protocol, input values and runtime in uninterrupted and fresh-resume processes
Resume evaluation at step16 and subsequent loss/gradient/read/write records match uninterrupted reference exactly
Final heads, optimizer and RNG match uninterrupted reference exactly
Final fixed-clip evaluation bank hashes and losses match exactly
stop: Stop at first failed integrity check, retain differences and artifacts. No efficacy/test authorization even if this diagnostic passes.
optimization_signal: Descriptive TRAIN check only: final equal-clip loss falls at least 1%, neither clip worsens more than 2%. Both matched arms must complete before interpreting this comparison.
prior_evidence: key_adapter_optimization_validity_v1/single_thread_replica_comparison.json; original two-thread fixed-training failure remains preserved
